posts.title: Scientists Just Connected the Dots Between Viruses and… Everything
posts.description: Most people catch many viruses in their lives– for example, over 90% of adults have Epstein-Barr virus , and adults catch the flu about once every 5 years. For a long time, catching frequent viruses was considered both inevitable and harmless. But it turns out that common, seemingly-mild viruses have disturbing long-term health impacts.
